svg.title: The Five-Move Demo
svg.desc: A five-step program sequence and matching floor path. The robot drives 30 centimeters, turns 90 degrees, drives 20 centimeters, turns 180 degrees, then drives back over the same 20-centimeter segment.

path.aria-label: Follow the calls in order. Turns happen in place; moves 3 and 5 share one path.
Drive 20 cm along the new path.
Drive back over the same 20 cm.
One program • five calls • one continuous route
Moves 3 and 5 use the exact same strip of floor.
The two vertical arrows are offset only so both directions remain visible.
